newsitem.title: USA: First Savings Bancorp to buy back shares.
newsitem.headline: First Savings Bancorp to buy back shares.

text.p: First Savings Bancorp Inc said Monday it has adopted a stock repurchase plan.
The number of shares to be repurchased has not yet been determined. A company spokesman said the number of shares will likely be set within the next month.
The company has 3.744 million shares of common stock outstanding.

The plan allows First Savings to repurchase shares in the open market or in privately negotiated transactions at appropriate times to allow it to enhance the value of its stock for its shareholders and to manage its capital, the company said.
First Savings has assets of $257 million and shareholders' equity of $67 million as of June 30.
